_note: Animal classes (every animal has one, in animals.json "class") and the Specialists' traits ("trait"). Where each class stands in an army: "formation"; how many animals a card brings: "squads". counters: extra damage (percent) one class does to another; less for a negative number (Tanks are armored: everyone but Tank Destroyers does 30% less to them). A class's targets and range override the animal's own (Ranged reach at least `range` tiles; Air flies). line: the one short line shown when you hold a card.

classes.name: Air
classes.line: Flies. Only Ranged and Air can hit it.

traits.name: Burrow
traits.line: Digs under and pops up behind the enemy.

traits.name: Stun
traits.line: Every second hit freezes the target.

prefer._note: Who goes after what first, if it's within this many tiles: Tank Destroyers look for Tanks, Ranged for Air.

squads._note: How many animals one card brings into a fight (a squad), and how strong each one is, by class: `units` animals, each with hp_pct and damage_pct of the card's health and bite (so a squad of 3 at 36% is a little more than one animal at 100%). radius: how much room each takes (tiles). spacing: how far apart neighbours stand in a line (tiles, centre to centre). line_max: how many fit in one line before a second line forms behind. leash: how far (tiles) an animal may leave its place in the formation to fight. Specialists are single elite animals, stronger each, standing on the flanks. A Mythic (any class) is one big hero carrying share_pct of a whole squad of its class (all of its squad's health and bite in one animal), drawn hero_scale times as big.

formation._note: How an army lines up (tiles). Ranks from the front: the Tank wall, the Tank Destroyer line, then the Ranged ranks; Air hovers over the Tank Destroyer line (`over`: a rank drawn over another, `over_offset` tiles behind it, taking no room of its own). Specialists stand on the flanks of the rank their trait belongs to (rank_of_row: Burrowers on the wall's, the rest on the Tank Destroyers', where they can reach a fight): at an outer end of their lane's first line. rank_gap: extra room between ranks; line_gap: between two lines of the same rank. Every other line of a `stagger` rank is shifted half a place so all can shoot. An animal whose reach (its card's range, or its attack style's) is at least back_reach tiles stands in a line of its own at the very back of its rank, so its range shows (the King Cobra). Lanes (battle_rules.json "lanes"): each rank's squads are spread over the field's three lanes, the middle one first, each lane with its own lines of that rank, keeping lane_margin tiles from the lane's edges.
